projects.description: React has evolved a lot since the initial development of react-native elements. The library needs to update its codebase to adopt a new coding pattern to optimize the performance. With the introduction of Functional Components, a new approach of Hooks was introduced, which makes code clean and more efficient in use. The idea is to migrate components to functions & hooks, tests to React Native Testing Library, and use of the latest APIs of React Native, including Pressable & Animated API

projects.description: Currently, the process of generating the documentation is manual and it requires updating the docs every time there is a change in props. We can use document generator tools to generate documents effectively using scripts. Work on internationalization of documentation. Along with this make a Web App which showcases components.
